name: No elitism: the best tour is lost
lesson: Without elites the best tour of a generation can disappear from the next one, and the search keeps losing what it found.
lookFor: Same instance, seed and starting population as “berlin52: the nearest neighbour and the optimum”. With no elites the best tour of the generation is worse than the one before it in 183 of the 500 generations (with two elites that happens in none of 500 generations of any of the seeds 1 to 30), and the run ends 87.9 % over the optimum, at 14,168, against 16.6 %. Over seeds 1 to 30 the run without elites is behind at generations 200, 300 and 500 in all 30 runs; the median gap after 500 generations is 70.5 %.
